summary_ja: JUPITERについて、2026年6月rankとaccess受付の一方でEarly Access・pre-acceptanceが継続している状態、Booster-only、1 nodeから全系、最大12時間、node非共有という現行policyを追加しました。rank、利用可能性、正式acceptance、全module完成を分離します。単一モデルによる暫定調査でConsensusは未完了です。
summary_en: For JUPITER, this update records June 2026 rankings and access availability alongside continued early-access and pre-acceptance status, plus the current Booster-only policy from one node to full system for up to 12 hours with no node sharing. Ranking, availability, formal acceptance, and completion of all modules are kept separate. This is provisional single-model research with Consensus incomplete.

items.name_ja: JUPITERは利用可能だがEarly Access・pre-acceptance
items.name_en: JUPITER is accessible but remains in early access and pre-acceptance
items.statement_ja: EuroHPCはJUPITERへのaccessを案内し、Boosterを2026年6月TOP500 5位、Green500 17位と掲載しています。一方、JSC user documentはJUPITERをEarly Access、installation stage、pre-productionと明記し、service statusもpre-acceptanceで短時間に利用不能となり得るとしています。したがってrank掲載とallocation受付は、正式acceptance、production SLA、全moduleの完成を意味しません。
items.statement_en: EuroHPC advertises access to JUPITER and lists its Booster at number five in the June 2026 TOP500 and number 17 in the Green500. In contrast, JSC user documentation explicitly describes JUPITER as early access, in the installation stage, and pre-production, while the service status calls it pre-acceptance and subject to short-notice unavailability. Ranking and allocation availability therefore do not establish formal acceptance, a production SLA, or completion of all modules.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: HPCI整備の進捗表示は、設置、電源投入、benchmark提出、early user、部分allocation、acceptance、production、全機能提供を分けるべきです。
items.hpci_relevance_en: HPCI deployment reporting should separate installation, power-on, benchmark submission, early users, partial allocations, acceptance, production, and full feature availability.
adoption_conditions_ja: 各milestoneの日付、対象node/module、利用者範囲、SLA、未解決issueを記録する。
rank提出時構成と通常allocationで利用できる構成を分ける。
acceptance criteriaとproduction移行判定を公開可能な範囲で示す。
adoption_conditions_en: Record dates, covered nodes and modules, user scope, SLA, and unresolved issues for each milestone.
Separate the ranking configuration from resources available in ordinary allocations.
Publish acceptance criteria and production-cutover decisions to the extent possible.

items.name_ja: Boosterのみ、1 nodeから全系、最大12時間のEarly Access queue
items.name_en: Booster-only early-access queue from one node to full system for up to 12 hours
items.statement_ja: 現行batch documentはpartitionを`booster`一つに限定し、1 nodeからsystem sizeまで、default 1時間・最大12時間、nodeは一user jobが占有しjob間共有なしとしています。login nodeのprocess数は20、memoryはnodeの25%に制限され、compute nodeからのinternet利用も制限されます。これはlarge-scale試験を可能にしますが、production時のpartition、queue limit、full-system availability、preemption、service workloadとの共存条件は確定値ではありません。
items.statement_en: Current batch documentation exposes a single `booster` partition, from one node to system size, with a one-hour default and 12-hour maximum wall time and exclusive nodes with no sharing between jobs. Login nodes limit users to 20 processes and 25% of node memory, and internet use from compute nodes is restricted. This enables large-scale testing, but production partitions, queue limits, full-system availability, preemption, and coexistence with service workloads are not yet established as final policy.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: early accessでは大規模porting枠を用意しつつ、production policyへそのまま外挿せず、利用実績からjob size・walltime・service共存を再設計する必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Early access can provide large porting windows, but production job size, wall time, and service coexistence should be redesigned from usage evidence rather than copied directly.
adoption_conditions_ja: requested/allocated/used node-hoursをjob sizeとwalltime別に集計する。
policy変更時にqueued job、pinning、container、checkpointへの影響を通知・検証する。
adoption_conditions_en: Aggregate requested, allocated, and used node-hours by job size and wall time.
Separate capacity for full-system tests, routine science, interactive services, and maintenance.
Notify and validate effects of policy changes on queued jobs, pinning, containers, and checkpoints.
